name: questionnaire-submit-state
title: Questionnaire: Submit State
description: `QuestionnaireSubmit` is a Stateful Button. Own the request in `onSubmit` and pass `state` (`idle`, `loading`, `success`) with `onStateChange`; the button shows the spinner and success label, blocks repeat submits, and resets after `successDuration`. Omit `state` and it behaves like a normal button.
